 LeBron James Player Props and Odds: Bucks vs. Sixers
 João Pedro Nieri
 Published: 9 hours ago
 LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers host the Milwaukee Bucks on Saturday, November 21, with the veteran forward looking to keep making a positive impact and help the Sixers maintain the top position in the Eastern Conference.
 Lebron James is playing his first season with the Philadelphia 76ers after spending eight years with the Los Angeles Lakers . The four-time NBA champion has averaged 15.7 points, 6.8 rebounds and 6.8 assists per game through his first 12 appearances of the 2026-27 season.
 The veteran forward has taken on an important role in Philadelphia's rotation, contributing as both a scorer and a playmaker. His ability to create opportunities for teammates and contribute across multiple statistical categories makes him an interesting player to watch ahead of Saturday's matchup.
 James and the 76ers will face the Milwaukee Bucks at the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia. Tipoff is scheduled for 1:00 PM Eastern.
